description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; free trial: add "trial": true or use try_free). [SEO, security and site verdicts] Scores how visible and usable a site is for AI assistants and agents (0-100, grade A-F): robots.txt rules for AI search and training crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended...), noindex/noai, /llms.txt quality, schema.org JSON-LD, sitemap, title/description/canonical/lang, Open Graph, content readable without JavaScript, and agent discovery files (/.well-known/x402, MCP server card, A2A agent card, OpenAPI). Findings with fixes. Obeys robots.txt.

trial.description: Optional. true = free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day), else the payment terms.

url.description: Public http(s) URL or bare domain, e.g. https://example.com
